summary: Arkane's first-person RPG, best preserved through its open-source modern engine port.

entries.title: Arx Fatalis
entries.definitive_edition: Arx Libertatis using the original PC data

emulation.notes: Use original GOG, Steam, or retail 1.21 data; the source code is open but the game assets are not.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 4K/ultrawide-capable output with the source port's modern renderer and interface fixes.

primary.version: GOG or Steam game data with Arx Libertatis
primary.why: Arx Libertatis is the maintained cross-platform port of the released source code. It still requires the original proprietary game data, while fixing modern-system issues and enabling high resolutions, scalable interface behavior, ultrawide support, and an uncapped frame rate without changing the authored content.
primary.how_to_play: Install a legitimate GOG or Steam copy patched to 1.21, then install the current Arx Libertatis release and point it at that data. Use native resolution, scale the interface for readability, and cap frame rate only if the current build shows timing issues.

secondary.exclusive_content: No exclusive content; original executable fallback.
secondary.what_to_play: Use the DRM-free 1.21 GOG/Steam executable only if a specific Arx Libertatis regression blocks progress.
secondary.why: It preserves exact original-engine behavior but has resolution, HUD-scaling, and modern-compatibility limitations.

all_releases.fidelity: Original data in Arx Libertatis: modern resolutions, ultrawide support, scalable presentation, uncapped frame rate.
all_releases.reason: primary: best modern fidelity and stability while using the original game assets.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console port with controller-focused interface.
all_releases.reason: skip: lower fidelity and no verified content absent from the PC release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Arx Libertatis changes the engine layer, not the proprietary content; retain the original executable only as a behavior fallback.

entries.remaster_caveats: Arx Libertatis is a source port, not a remaster: it needs legally obtained original assets. The unmodified 1.21 executable has tiny HUD elements at high resolutions and can fail at very wide/high output modes.
